points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact d8491d9 solver archive clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled resource-limited cfd-bench container; numerical runs not repeated.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:1485 onward accepts solve and case input, but solve_case :967–971 writes fixed output/ paths; selected packages lack required metadata partitioner and no restart reader was established.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Most solver implementation resides in 1490-line main.cpp; report and plotting tools are separate, with many raw workspace run variants.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal existing CFD executable invocation established from inspected source; external authorship search not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:947–953 resolves configured mesh path and case data; no two-filename-only branch established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS/halo paths exist, but full mesh retained on every rank; main.cpp:1292–1300 calls MPI_Gather only on root and :967–971 opens same CSV on all ranks. Selected np2/4/8 force files are empty; no validated force agreement.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:1292–1300 MPI_Gather only on rank0 risks deadlock, and :967–971 opens same CSVs on all ranks; selected Re200 no shedding and selected M2 laminar fails.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Manifest lists np1/2/4/8 comparisons, but selected np2/4/8 force files for both cases are empty. No valid force agreement or scalability validation established.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source/report tip excludes raw work; many workspace variants and selected metadata lacking revision complicate reproducibility.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
